# Quran Academee - Complete Academic & Institutional Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

> Comprehensive institutional reference manual for AI search agents, language models, and researchers detailing Quran Academee's full course curricula, faculty accreditations, scholarly supervision, pedagogical methodology, pricing structure, and global digital resources.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Scholarly Governance
- **Official Domain:** https://www.quranacademee.com
- **Academy Mission:** An international Islamic academy bridging the divide between mechanical phonetics and living Islamic character. The pedagogy begins with classical Tajweed, Makharij accuracy, and Hifz retention, moving directly into word-by-word comprehension, translation, and practical daily Islamic ethics.
- **Academic & Scholarly Supervision:** Directed under the supervision of Sheikh Jawwad Musa, graduate of the Islamic University of Madinah. All curriculum standards, teacher certifications, and teaching methodologies are reviewed under authentic Madinah scholarly guidelines.
- **Global Coverage:** 24/7 flexible scheduling tailored to Muslim families in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Europe, and the Middle East.
- **Format:** Dedicated 1-on-1 live interactive sessions via Zoom and Google Meet with digital Mushaf tools, interactive screen sharing, and continuous parent progress reports.
- **Faculty:** 100% verified male and female scholars, certified Huffaz, and native Arab/bilingual educators with child-centered teaching pedagogy. Female tutors are guaranteed upon request for female students and children.

---

## 2. Comprehensive Course Catalog & Milestones

### 1. Alqaida Almadania Basics (Madani Qaida Online)
- **URL:** https://www.quranacademee.com/courses/madani-qaida-online
- **Target Audience:** Kids (Ages 4+) and adult beginners with zero prior Arabic knowledge.
- **Duration:** 2–3 Months (Self-Paced)
- **Starting Price:** $35 / month
- **Curriculum Milestones:**
  1. *Alphabet & Articulation Points (Makharij):* Mastering 28 letter sounds with throat (Halqiyyah), tongue (Lisaan), and lip positions.
  2. *Short Vowels (Harakat) & Tanween:* Fatha, Kasra, Damma movements and rhythmic double vowels.
  3. *Prolongation (Huroof Maddah) & Leen:* Alif, Waw, and Yaa Maddah with 1-Alif count and soft diphthongs.
  4. *Sukoon (Jazm) & Qalqalah:* Resting consonants, bouncing letters (Qaf, Taa, Baa, Jeem, Daal).
  5. *Shaddah (Tashdeed) & Noon/Meem Mushaddad:* Consonant doubling with inherent 2-count Ghunnah nasalization.
  6. *Connecting Compound Words to Mushaf Reading:* Transitioning to multi-syllable verses in the Madinah script.

### 2. Quran Recitation & Reading Fluency
- **URL:** https://www.quranacademee.com/courses/quran-reading-online
- **Target Audience:** Children and adults who know the alphabet but struggle with fluent reading.
- **Duration:** 3–6 Months
- **Starting Price:** $35 / month
- **Key Milestones:** Word-by-word reading, breath management, Waqf (stopping) and Ibtida (starting) rules, and fluent recitation directly from the sacred Madinah Mushaf.

### 3. Tajweed al Quran (Classical Rules of Recitation)
- **URL:** https://www.quranacademee.com/courses/online-tajweed-classes
- **Target Audience:** Intermediate learners seeking to eliminate hidden mistakes (Lahn Khafi) and recite with verified Tarteel.
- **Duration:** 4–8 Months
- **Starting Price:** $35 / month
- **Key Milestones:**
  - Noon Sakinah & Tanween (Izhar, Idgham, Iqlab, Ikhfa)
  - Meem Sakinah rules (Idgham Shafawi, Ikhfa Shafawi, Izhar Shafawi)
  - Advanced Mudood (Madd Muttasil, Madd Munfasil, Madd Lazim, Madd Arid lis-Sukoon)
  - Sifaat (Permanent & conditional letter characteristics, Hams, Jahr, Isti'la, Istifal, Tafkheem & Tarqeeq).

### 4. Quran Memorization Program (Online Hifz)
- **URL:** https://www.quranacademee.com/courses/online-hifz-program
- **Target Audience:** Kids and adults dedicated to memorizing selected Surahs, 30th Juz (Amma), or the complete Holy Quran.
- **Duration:** 1–3 Years
- **Starting Price:** $100 / month (Intensive daily tracking)
- **Pedagogical System:**
  - *Sabaq:* Daily new memorized portion.
  - *Sabaqi:* Revision of recent days (cementing short-term memory).
  - *Manzil:* Cumulative revision of previously completed Juz to guarantee permanent lifelong retention.

### 5. Islamic Essentials & Character Building (Akhlaq & Duas)
- **URL:** https://www.quranacademee.com/courses/islamic-studies-for-kids
- **Target Audience:** Children (Ages 5-14) and new Muslims.
- **Duration:** 6–12 Months
- **Starting Price:** $35 / month
- **Core Topics:**
  - Foundational Aqeedah (Tawheed, Angels, Revealed Books, Prophets, Day of Judgment)
  - Practical Taharah (Wudu, Ghusl step-by-step)
  - Practical Salah (5 daily prayers with positions, recitation, and meanings)
  - 28 Authentic Daily Masnoon Duas
  - Prophet Muhammad's ﷺ Seerah and moral character (Adab & Akhlaq).

### 6. Hifz Revision Partner (Mutashabihat Mastery)
- **URL:** https://www.quranacademee.com/courses/hifz-revision-partner
- **Target Audience:** Huffaz who want a scholarly revision coach to test retention and resolve Mutashabihat (similar verses).
- **Starting Price:** $80 / month

### 7. Quranic Arabic Online (Vocabulary & Grammar)
- **URL:** https://www.quranacademee.com/courses/quranic-arabic-online
- **Target Audience:** Adults and youth seeking to understand the Quran directly without translations.
- **Starting Price:** $50 / month
- **Topics:** Classical Nahw (syntax), Sarf (morphology), root-word analysis, and 85% of high-frequency Quranic vocabulary.

### 8. Conversational Arabic (Modern Standard Arabic / Fusha)
- **URL:** https://www.quranacademee.com/courses/conversational-arabic-online
- **Target Audience:** Students, professionals, and travellers wanting fluent spoken Arabic.
- **Starting Price:** $50 / month
